name: beethoven-extension
summary: The Beethoven browser extension, the native-messaging bridge it ships and the store releases: the student's client for their own Claude Code worker on the university's grid.

exports.summary: The agreement and the privacy statement the extension shows and records acceptance of, each headed by its own 'Version N, yyyy-mm-dd.' line (TERMS_VERSION and TERMS_DATE in extension/src/core/terms.ts follow LICENSE.txt's); the website renders them as /beethoven/terms.html and /beethoven/privacy.html
The product's version: the "version" field of this file and nothing else in it, which the website prints beside the texts
